'''Big Wayne''' is a radio guest in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

He is voiced by "Big" [[Wayne Oliver]].

==History==
===Background===
Big Wayne is a dealer who lives in [[Glen Park]], [[Los Santos (3D Universe)|Los Santos]].

[[Radio Los Santos (3D Universe)|Radio Los Santos]]'s DJ [[Julio G]] gives him a shout out, and Big Wayne himself even calls in at one point saying: "''This is Big Wayne, I've got a special price on Z's, hit me up''".
